collision_1_115_17.content_check: oshb Ps.115.17 text = 'לֹ֣א הַ֭מֵּתִים יְהַֽלְלוּ יָ֑הּ וְ֝לֹ֗א כָּל יֹרְדֵ֥י דוּמָֽה' -- contains the skeleton-matching 3mp imperfect construction 'yehalelu Yah' inside the negated clause 'the dead do not praise Yah', classified 'interior' by the sweep (not verse-initial/final) -- matches the row's 'verbal collocation' label exactly.

collision_2_22_27.dual_cite_arithmetic: Ps 22 is shift+1 (k=1); web22.27 -> mt22.28 is arithmetically self-consistent with the shift rule in isolation.
collision_2_22_27.content_check: oshb Ps.22.28 text = 'יִזְכְּר֤וּ וְיָשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה כָּל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לְ֝פָנֶ֗יךָ כָּֽל מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת גּוֹיִֽם' -- contains NO 'halelu/yah'-pattern skeleton match at all (independently swept: 0 hits). The actual skeleton-matching full-divine-name collision ('yehalelu YHWH' = 'they shall praise Yahweh') is one verse EARLIER, at oshb Ps.22.27 (= web Ps.22.26): text = 'יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑יו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְכֶ֣ם לָעַֽד'. Triple-confirmed: (1) oshb Hebrew bytes at Ps.22.27 contain the skeleton hit, Ps.22.28 does not; (2) verse_map_web.json's own 'mt' back-reference field maps web:Ps.22.26 -> mt:Ps.22.27 and web:Ps.22.27 -> mt:Ps.22.28; (3) the WEB English rendering at Ps.22.26 reads 'They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him' (matching the collision) while Ps.22.27 reads 'All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh' (no praise language).

defects.description: The second Halleluyah-frame collision disclosure cites the wrong verse pair. Row states "web:Ps.22.27 = oshb:Ps.22.28, a full-divine-name collision" -- the dual-cite is arithmetically well-formed (Ps 22 shift+1) but points one verse past the actual collision. The genuine skeleton-tier 'yehalelu YHWH' collision (byte-verified) sits at oshb:Ps.22.27 = web:Ps.22.26, not oshb:Ps.22.28 = web:Ps.22.27. oshb:Ps.22.28 contains no Halleluyah-pattern text at all (0 hits on an independent skeleton sweep).
defects.byte_evidence: oshb Ps.22.27 and Ps.22.28 full texts captured above; verse_map_web.json back-references for Ps.22.26/Ps.22.27 captured above.

results.notes: This is the task's mandatory additional target (sweep-7 halleluyah recut under B-9). The 24-frame figure and the 115:17 collision are byte-confirmed correct. The 22:27/22:28 collision citation is confirmed WRONG by one verse against oshb bytes, the WEB back-reference map, and the WEB English text -- three independent lines of evidence agree. This is a content-semantic error (wrong verse cited for a real claim) that the corpus's mechanical validators (citation_sweep.py, check_refs_mirror.py) do not catch, because they verify ref syntax and WEB/MT shift arithmetic, not whether the cited verse's actual text matches the semantic collision being disclosed.
